name: Kamikitayama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamikitayama village emblem in white: an angular stylised character of interlocking strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikitayama, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kamikitayama village emblem — an angular stylised character of interlocking strokes
